claim: Move the non-application Sourcery platform and shell to algebra-owned Git sources while reducing MJS to a minimal imperative kernel. Preserve material crossings as explicit Seams until every consumer has crossed and retirement has been witnessed.

templeObservation.scope: Exact read-only source observation; not Git receiving, merge, activation or current-main authority.

liveCollisionObservation.disposition: Do not duplicate or edit this active tranche from this lane. Reconcile only after its Git disposition is known.

architecturalDecision.sourceAuthority: Git repositories own durable source and provenance. Commits, tags, packages and CI receipts identify exact candidates.
architecturalDecision.templeRole: Temple may consume, qualify and run immutable Git artifacts during migration; it is not the replacement authoring authority and must not receive a second copy merely to restate Git source.
architecturalDecision.algebraRule: All platform and shell decisions, policies, mappings, defaults, selection laws, refusal laws and state transitions are authored as algebra.
architecturalDecision.kernelRule: MJS remains only where the machine must perform an effect, observe bytes or time, cross a process/transport boundary, parse or evaluate the algebra, or implement a fixed codec. Boundary code cannot choose platform policy.
architecturalDecision.migrationRule: Semantic correspondence is required; byte-for-byte faithfulness to failed decomposition is not. Symmetry breaks are recorded faithfully and then either preserved as essential Seams or deliberately collapsed with witnesses.
architecturalDecision.seamRule: Legacy behavior may remain reachable behind an accidental Seam only while named consumers cross. Seamless completion requires zero open residuals, legacy runtime unreachability and an accepted retirement witness.

phases.name: audit
phases.purpose: Trace every platform/shell MJS file reachable from accepted entrypoints and classify its functions by semantic decision, interpreter/primitive, external effect, evidence fixture or dead/duplicate code.
phases.exit: Every reachable function has one disposition and exact source identity; unknown dynamic edges remain visible residuals.

phases.name: extract
phases.purpose: Move semantic decisions into authored algebra without copying accidental implementation structure.
phases.exit: New algebra preserves declared invariants, records deliberate corrections and leaves effects behind typed boundaries.

phases.name: collate
phases.purpose: Unify repeated reductions into common platform laws and assign each remaining effect to the minimal kernel.
phases.exit: No duplicated platform policy remains across repositories and dependency direction is acyclic and explicit.

phases.name: collapse
phases.purpose: Switch consumers to immutable Git artifacts, prove legacy runtime unreachability and retire accidental Seams.
phases.exit: All consumers crossed, zero blocking residuals, legacy unreachable, independent runtime observation accepted.
